title: win goal demo directive narrows 64-bit uint to u32 without a pre-cast range check (silent truncation)
detail: parse_uint returns platform uint (64-bit); `win goal 4294967296` parses ok, then u32(v) truncates silently to 0. The sibling `win surge` branch added in this same hunk validates (v > 100) before its cast; the goal branch keeps the unchecked cast.
recommended_fix: Reject values above max(u32) before the cast (e.g. `if v > u64(max(u32))`), mirroring the surge branch's validate-then-cast order.
